overview: The Medford Arts Council met to introduce new members, review ongoing public art projects, and prepare for the upcoming annual grant cycle. The council discussed its approximately $100,000 budget and established a schedule for evaluating grant applications through November.

items.title: Introductions and Membership Process
items.summary: Existing and prospective members introduced themselves and reviewed the requirement to attend three meetings prior to being officially appointed to the board.

items.title: Logan Park Tree Project Update
items.summary: Tyler Tostin announced that an artist has been selected for the Logan Park tree sculpture project, which is expected to begin next month and finish within eight months.

items.title: Tufts Field Project Proposal
items.summary: The council submitted a proposal for Tufts University master's students to conduct research and provide data on cultural planning and department expansion models in Medford.

items.title: Financial Reconciliation and Budget Update
items.summary: Board members discussed reconciling the annual budget of approximately $100,000, which includes roughly $37,000 from the state and $60,000 to $65,000 from the city.

items.title: Grant Application Status and Adjudication Process
items.summary: Tyler Tostin reported that 16 applications totaling nearly $30,000 have been received so far and reviewed the weighted scoring rubric and disciplinary categories used for evaluation.

items.title: Marketing and Outreach
items.summary: The council discussed strategies to diversify the applicant pool by sharing grant information through social media, neighborhood email lists, and local maker spaces.

items.title: Meeting Schedule and Planning
items.summary: The council scheduled its next meetings for October 19 and November 16, with a virtual wrap-up meeting set for December 14.

items.title: Grantee Celebration
items.summary: Members discussed early planning and potential local venues for a spring event to celebrate new grant recipients.
